text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. First, try to eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, regular exercise, like walking or swimming, keeps your body strong and helps you feel happier. Third, don't forget sleep: most adults need about seven to eight hours each night. Mental health is just as important, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by spending time with family and friends and enjoying your hobbies. Small daily habits can make a big difference.
